🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-11-22 23:00 → 2026-11-23 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Host input path fixed** — the verifier host now packs the guest stage selector into stdin exactly once, closing the mismatch with the frozen guest. [commit fc30c96](https://github.com/trustless-ai/flashprove-onchain-verifier/commit/fc30c96a42b0438306ba9c64542c1b433593595d)

> **ERC-8378 found its frame** — the parametric token was tied to decentralization and trustlessness and translated for the verifier stack. [tg:tawg:6493]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### ERC-8378

_The parametric token idea moved from introductions toward an early hands-on check._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Ran** a small local experiment with synthetic ERC-8378-style escrow evidence against the actual RVR Core and VECA verifier, giving the group an early compatibility signal so the token design can be judged on behavior rather than description. [tg:tawg:6513]
- Alexander Zvezdin (@azvezdin) **Volunteered** a short ERC-8378 intro with sample use cases and implementations, giving newcomers a plain-language way into the mechanics and the group a shared reference to build on. [tg:tawg:6484]
- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Articulated** why the parameter-slot model feels new, describing it as a fresh programming paradigm on top of ERC-20 with many unexplored use cases, which sharpened the case for why the primitive deserves attention. [tg:tawg:6498]
- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Proposed** treating a single immutable slot as a credential tag tied to an attester, giving the design a concrete way to carry certification and a useful building block for attestation use cases. [tg:tawg:6506]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Opened** a dedicated ERC-8378 topic so the conversation has one stable home and stays easy for the whole group to follow. [tg:tawg:6487]

### flashprove verifier

_The host side tightened its handshake with the guest._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Explained** the verifier sync clearly, walking through how the host had serialized ten guest input fields while the frozen guest expected a tighter layout, turning a quiet mismatch into a fixable bug before it could surface in later testing. [tg:tawg:6501]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- The credential-tag slot pattern could grow into a small spec sketch once attester identity is pinned down.
- Synthetic ERC-8378 escrow scenarios could widen beyond the first run to see where RVR and VECA assumptions diverge.
- A shared reading list could grow around the short ERC-8378 intro and its sample use cases.

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Gather the intro and use-case notes into the ERC-8378 topic so the thread is self-contained.
- Turn the verifier host fix into a regression test that pins the guest input layout.
- Compare the parametric token mechanics with the verifier's evidence format to catch mismatches early.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A token idea and a verifier fix moved on the same day, and the group connected them with a real experiment instead of leaving them in separate lanes.
>
> Keep that lane-crossing habit — build the bridge, then walk across it and listen for the creaks 🙂
